method: Per-stock common rows across all feature sets; expanding chronological walk-forward folds; 4-row purge; identical target, model factories, train-only chronological calibration and validation-only threshold selection.
target: direction of executable return from next close to close four bars after signal (3 bars held)

cost_assumption.note: Cost proxy only; not a full Indian transaction-cost calculation.

limitations: A stock is included only if real candles and sufficient usable rows were retrieved.
News coverage may be sparse; missing news is neutral, not evidence of no news.
News sentiment remains the existing keyword-based baseline.
Equal-stock macro averages do not imply statistical significance.
Three folds per stock are an initial research comparison, not proof of generalization.
No orders are placed; trading readiness is not inferred from this experiment.
